question.whyItMatters: Pavel reconfirms every guest two days before recording.

text.text: Episodes link to a guest and a sponsor. Move each one from Idea to Published and keep the task list short.
The first message decides whether the guest says yes. Make it easy to answer in one line.
Keep the first message under 120 words.
Say what you loved about their story.
Name the show, the audience size and recording length.

"Hi Tamsin, I loved the story of how you turned the workshop around. I host a weekly show for people running small shops, about 4,000 listeners, forty minutes a recording. Could we record on a weekday morning, either of these two windows? Thanks for considering it."
Follow up once after a week with a single sentence.
Then set the guest back to Prospect and move on.
Publishing is a sequence of small checks. Do them in order, and ticking them as you go keeps the release calm.
Audio uploaded and checked on a phone
Mark the episode Published so the sponsor count updates.
Watch the first day of downloads and note anything odd in the episode row.
